overview.name: Tradr 2X Long RGTI Daily ETF
overview.description: Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the daily performance of RGTI. The Advisor attempts to consistently apply leverage to increase the fund’s exposure to 200% of RGTI, and expects to rebalance the fund’s holdings daily to maintain such exposure. The fund is non-diversified.
